meta.methodology: Each cause/effect node not already assigned to a bechina-based package was assigned by its ESSENTIAL NATURE to the most fitting existing package. Polarity was considered for each assignment. No new packages were needed.

assignments.reason: The 'complete da'at' (דעת השלם) is the actualized, perfected knowledge that bridges human and divine da'at. Its essential nature is identical to שְׁלֵמוּת הַדַּעַת — both refer to the state of fully realized knowledge, which is the core domain of Package 1. The teaching states: 'when one merits the complete da'at, one merits children' (line 24), placing this squarely in the da'at/heh domain.

This node describes the capacity to arrive at shleimut ha-da'at — 'being able to reach the completeness of da'at.' Its essential nature is the attainment of complete da'at, which is the defining concept of Package 1. It is the result-state of the three preparations (Berakhot 57b triad) flowing into the da'at domain (line 13: 'when he has all these preparations, he can come to shleimut ha-da'at').

assignments.node_id: להשלים את דעתו, שיהא שלם בדעת
assignments.node_text: וּלְהַשְׁלִים אֶת דַּעְתּוֹ, שֶׁיְּהֵא שָׁלֵם בְּדַעַת
assignments.reason: This node — 'to complete one's da'at, to be complete in da'at' — names the process of reaching shleimut ha-da'at. Its essential nature is da'at completion, the core concept of Package 1. Though it appears as the effect-side of the kiruv eitza edge (outreach leads to completing da'at), the concept itself belongs to the da'at domain by nature.

This node — 'to complete their da'at' — is a variant expression of the same concept as 'להשלים את דעתו, שיהא שלם בדעת'. Its essential nature is da'at completion. The teaching uses this in line 7 to explain why tzaddikim pursue people: 'not to increase their honor, but to complete their da'at.' The concept is squarely within the da'at domain of Package 1.

assignments.node_id: מי שהוא שלם בדעתו, שהוציא אותו מכח אל הפעל, והשיג בדעתו מה שאפשר לדעת האדם להשיג בדעתו.
assignments.node_text: וּמִי שֶׁהוּא שָׁלֵם בְּדַעְתּוֹ, שֶׁהוֹצִיא אוֹתוֹ מִכֹּחַ אֶל הַפֹּעַל, וְהִשִּׂיג בְּדַעְתּוֹ מַה שֶּׁאֶפְשָׁר לְדַעַת הָאָדָם לְהַשִּׂיג בְּדַעְתּוֹ.
assignments.reason: This compound node describes the person who has achieved complete da'at — who has brought their intellect from potential (koach) to actuality (po'al) and attained the maximum humanly possible knowledge. Its essential nature is actualized, perfected da'at. The teaching says this person's da'at 'nurses from divine da'at, which is the bechina of heh, and then they beget' (line 3). This is the human embodiment of Package 1's core concept.

assignments.node_id: וזה (ברכות נ"ז:): שלשה דברים מרחיבין דעתו של אדם, אשה נאה, ודירה, וכלים. אשה, הינו החמר מכנה בשם אשה. שיהא לו חמר ממזג במזג השוה, שיהא ראוי לקבל שכל: ודירה נאה, הינו היראה, כמאמר (שבת ל"א:): חבל על מאן דלית לה דרתא, כי צריך שיהא יראת חטאו קודמת לחכמתו (אבות פרק ג). וכלים, הינו תלמידים הגונים שיקבלו ממנו.
assignments.node_text: שְׁלשָׁה דְּבָרִים מַרְחִיבִין דַּעְתּוֹ שֶׁל אָדָם: אִשָּׁה נָאָה, וְדִירָה, וְכֵלִים
assignments.reason: This compound node encapsulates the entire Berakhot 57b teaching: 'three things broaden a person's da'at — a beautiful woman, a dwelling, and vessels,' together with the Rebbe's decoding of each as balanced matter, fear-of-sin, and worthy students respectively. Its essential nature is the triad of vessels/preconditions that enable da'at — exactly the domain of Package 2. This node is the aggregate expression of the three individual bechina pairs already in Package 2.

This node — 'children' — is an inflected form of בָּנִים already present in Package 3. Its essential nature is procreation/offspring, the core domain of Package 3. The teaching says: 'through complete da'at one merits children' (line 24). This is the fruit of the entire causal chain.

This node — 'begets/procreates' — is the active verbal form of הוֹלָדָה (procreation), the dominant node of Package 3. Its essential nature is the act of bringing forth offspring, whether physical or spiritual. The teaching says: 'his da'at nurses from divine da'at... and then he begets' (line 3).

assignments.node_id: עסק שעוסק עם בני אדם לקרבם לעבודת השם יתברך
assignments.node_text: עֵסֶק שֶׁעוֹסֵק עִם בְּנֵי אָדָם לְקָרְבָם לַעֲבוֹדַת הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
assignments.reason: This node — 'the engagement of working with people to bring them close to divine service' — describes the active practice through which the vessels (keilim) of Package 2 operate. The teaching explicitly frames this engagement as the mechanism by which students (כלים/תלמידים הגונים) sharpen the teacher's da'at: 'to complete one's da'at is impossible except through engaging with people to bring them close to divine service... for they sharpen his da'at, in the aspect of: from my students more than all' (line 4). The essential nature of this node is the instrumental/preparatory activity — the practice of kiruv as the operational dimension of the keilim. It belongs with the vessels that enable da'at, not with da'at itself (Package 1) or with the fruit of da'at (Package 3).

assignments.node_id: רודפים אחר בני אדם לקרבם לעבודתו יתברך.
assignments.node_text: וְרוֹדְפִים אַחַר בְּנֵי אָדָם לְקָרְבָם לַעֲבוֹדָתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ.
assignments.reason: This node — 'pursuing people to bring them close to divine service' — is a variant expression of the same essential activity as 'עסק שעוסק עם בני אדם לקרבם לעבודת השם יתברך'. The teaching in line 7 explains: 'the reason tzaddikim exert themselves and pursue people to bring them close to His service — this is not to increase their honor, but to complete their da'at, in the aspect of: from my students more than all.' The essential nature is the same instrumental kiruv activity that operates through the vessel-dynamic of teacher-student engagement (Package 2's domain).

stats.notes: All 10 unassigned cause/effect nodes were assigned to existing packages by essential nature. Five nodes relate to the da'at/shleimut domain (Package 1), three relate to the vessels/preconditions/kiruv-practice domain (Package 2), and two relate to the procreation/children domain (Package 3). No evil-polarity nodes were found in the cause/effect edges — Torah #53's eitza layer is entirely positive. No new packages were needed.
